scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:simulador: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run simulador --prefix backend"
scripts.check: node --check backend/routes/api.js && node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/config/db.js && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.predeploy: npm run check:env && npm run check
